title: Allan Gray welcomes new Group Five board
author: Leonard Krüger
body:
Allan Gray welcomes the results of today’s Group Five shareholders’ meeting, where eight individuals were elected to serve on Group Five’s board as non-executive directors.

We are pleased that the voting process has now been concluded.

We trust that the new non-executive board will be able to propel the company forward and ensure Group Five continues to play an important role in the future of South Africa.
